about: The one brand palette: for each day and each format, what opens the asset, what its body may carry, how it closes, its colour and its safe areas. Every maker reads this file (scripts/brand_palette.py), and the guard refuses any cut, carousel or meme whose opening, close, icon or wordmark differs from it for its day and format. No maker keeps its own copy of these rules. Built from the sheet Krish approved on 12 Nov 2026, held to the corpus he attached (docs/production/SOCIAL-BEST-PRACTICES-2026.md): no logo-only cold open, a brand sting may follow the hook but never precede it, a compact end beat on short video instead of a long card, the tall core box for every critical word and mark, a carousel's last slide a takeaway plus one action.

approved.words: I approve the brand palette sheet, but only if it falls in line with the attached.

logo_rule.ruled: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-17): the logo appears on no cut except the animated title frame and the final close card, wide and tall alike, so the opening seconds belong to the hook.
words: Krish, 2026-11-10, of the wide cut's mark tile: "I don't get why that icon even appears ... Get rid of it."

Krish, 2026-11-17: "we decided to eliminate all logos from everywhere other than the final animated close card and the title frame that animates as I introduce the title of the piece (like we did in the ai-music video) so we can have focuson the hook in the opening seconds"; then "yes, change the brand rules"
logo_rule.title_frame: The one full-frame title in the pause after he says the piece's title, the stacked logo underneath it (Wed 11 Nov, AI music: docs/plans/2026-11-11-wednesday/short-composite/brand_frames.py title_full). Never before the hook, and never a second intro.
logo_rule.from_why: Krish, 2026-11-18: "we have a strict NO ICONS, ONLY THE WORDMARK DURING THE TITLE FRAME AND THE CLOSING FRAME", after the icon tile still appeared on this week's cuts. The earlier date of 23 Nov kept the tile on every piece of the week of 16 Nov; that carve-out is gone: the rule binds every piece from the palette's own start, Mon 16 Nov, and Fri 13 Nov (a frozen engine, F33) is the only older piece.

series_close.ruled: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-26): every video, series or off day, wide or tall, ends on the v5 outro card, and the intro sting closes no cut. The card is the Library's outro (outro below): statement_card (16:9) is video-wide-outro and statement_beat (9:16) is video-vertical-outro, drawn in the locked v5 look (props.renderTheme makeyourmindup-v5), with no days row and no series name.
series_close.asked: Every series video still closes on the old intro-sting clips (day colours, the old gift-box wordmark). My recommendation: retire them and end on the plain v5 outro card.

No tagline, no Subscribe free, no stacked mark (V10 and V6 are retired: S3h replaced them), no days row and no series name.
outro.one_mark: Krish, 2026-11-25 (docs/ve/cards/library/ONE-MARK.md): "there should only be one of these wordmarks on any given artifact or page, and the headline should only appear once on any given medium"
outro.no_sub_brands: Krish, 2026-11-26: "it should just read like a curated news feed, the sub brands do not need to feature"

From 26 Nov the close is the Library's outro and says only its words, "Follow for more" and makeyourmindup.ai (series_close.outro).

statement_card.about: The v5 outro card, wide: every 16:9 cut dated from 26 Nov ends on it, series and off day alike (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-26: "1 agreed"; series_close). It is the Library's video-wide-outro: the climb bars fill the frame and drop into the staircase, S3h lands, then "Follow for more" and makeyourmindup.ai, settled by 2.4 s, then held long enough for YouTube's clickable end-screen elements (5 to 20 s, docs/production/CLOSING.md, end_hold_s). No days row, no series name, no burned-in click. A cut dated before 26 Nov keeps the statement card it was signed with: "Built to help you decide.", the masthead, Subscribe free and the address, the series days row on a series day.

statement_beat.about: The v5 outro card, tall: every 9:16 cut dated from 26 Nov ends on it, series and off day alike (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-26: "1 agreed"; series_close). It is the Library's video-vertical-outro played inside one compact end beat of at most 2 s: the climb bars drop into the staircase, S3h lands, then "Follow for more" and makeyourmindup.ai, settled by 1.33 s, inside the Library's content box. No days row, no series name. The only place a wordmark appears on a tall cut but the title frame. A cut dated before 26 Nov keeps the ink beat it was signed with, every word inside the tall core box.

house_close_slide.about: A carousel's last slide: the piece's own takeaway in one or two lines, then "Follow for more" with the Make Your Mind Up wordmark centred under it (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-18: "The last card of the carousel should always have the Make Your Mind Up word mark centred under the Follow for more text, as opposed to the word mark in the bottom-right corner and an amateur call to action"). No wordmark in the bottom-right corner on this card, never a bare call to action, never a thanks-for-swiping card.
